Both say a 'workspace-wide UTCDate newtype migration is a separate refactor' / 'out of scope for the typed-Id epic'.

jmap-types ships a UTCDate newtype. *-client methods currently take &str for date params (utc_start, utc_end, etc.) instead of &UTCDate. Same engineering argument as JMAP-6by7 (typed-Id epic, already closed): typed params make invalid states unrepresentable, eliminate redundant validation, and improve workspace consistency.

Scope:
- Convert &str / String 'this is a UTC date' params to &UTCDate across all *-client methods.
- Update call sites in tests and wiremock fixtures.
- Update README + PLAN drift sections in each crate.

This is a 0.2.0-class API break, but should be tracked as active work, not deferred. Coordinate with any other 0.2.0 changes if they cluster.
